name: Should I manage the renovation myself or hire a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: Should I manage the renovation myself or hire a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to self-manage or hire a general contractor depends on your experience, time availability, and the project's complexity. Self-management can save money on labor costs, but it requires significant time for coordination, material sourcing, and overseeing subcontractors. Hiring a general contractor provides expertise, established relationships with tradespeople, and project management, streamlining the process and often ensuring higher quality work. For most investment property owners, especially with complex renovations, a general contractor is recommended to save time and reduce stress.
acceptedAnswer.description: Self-managing can save money but demands time and experience. A general contractor offers expertise, manages the project, and is recommended for complex renovations.
